summary: RES-125: removed the correlated-physical-host-failure risk for the 3-node etcd/control-plane. Created a Hetzner SPREAD placement group (restormel-spread) and rolled all 3 nodes into it (Hetzner requires power-off to change placement group), guaranteeing no two nodes share a physical host (a single host failure now costs at most one node => etcd keeps 2/3 quorum). Per-node procedure: cordon -> graceful ACPI shutdown -> add-to-placement-group -> power-on -> verify Ready+etcd+CNPG. Chose CONTROLLED REBOOT over kubectl drain because (a) node2 was at 15/16 CSI volume-attach cap so a drain's mass volume migration risked attach failures, and (b) the 5 CNPG *-primary PDBs have disruptionsAllowed=0 which wedges eviction-based drains. master1 held 0 CNPG primaries (only replicas + crown-jewel singletons forgejo-0/infisical/surreal-0/prometheus which paused and resumed in place, no volume migration). node2 held all 5 CNPG primaries; graceful node-loss failover promoted every replica to master1/node4 cleanly (pg-plotbudget pre-moved).
